title: Request case
description: A described SDK call and the exact HTTP request it must send. Header names compare case-insensitively. body compares as JSON values: objects by key regardless of order, numbers by value. ordered_keys lists JSON pointers to objects whose key order must also be the order given in the call. body_checks replaces body when only the structure is fixed. mock (optional) is a scenario registered as request/<id>: the harness adds x-mock-scenario: request/<id> so a call that needs an answer (a batch by id) gets one. expect.requests replaces expect.request when one call sends several requests (an upload: the presign, the PUTs, then the decision).
